items.title: Record the decision not to pursue the B-3434 writer-owned-boundary follow-up
items.context: Replace the unassigned work-order posture with a declined/not-currently-justified disposition. Preserve the measured historical limitations as known boundaries, state why the cross-file refactor is disproportionate for the current plain-JSON production path, and list concrete reopen triggers.

happy.desc: The document explicitly records the post-B-3434 human decision that the writer-owned-boundary proposal is declined and not currently justified; WHY: the old unassigned work-order posture is the statement the user asked to change.

verification.command: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");const s=fs.readFileSync(\"docs/requirements/decisions/validation-evidence-artifact-growth.md\",\"utf8\");const must=[\"## Decision after B-3434\",\"Decision: decline the writer-owned canonical boundary as not currently justified.\",\"No follow-up story is planned or owned.\",\"this document is not an active work order.\"];if(!must.every(x=>s.includes(x)))process.exit(1);console.log(\"B-2220 happy-0 PASS\");"

happy.desc: The document keeps B-3434 accepted and preserves the shipped mechanism, measurements, transcripts, and historical finding identifiers as known limitations; WHY: declining new work must not rewrite the completed story or claim the limitations were fixed.

verification.command: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");const s=fs.readFileSync(\"docs/requirements/decisions/validation-evidence-artifact-growth.md\",\"utf8\");const must=[\"B-3434 remains accepted.\",\"## What ships\",\"**The measured numbers**\",\"smokeExpected=158 measured=158 hypothetical4SpaceStore=168 smokeStillPasses=true\",\"inherited-toJSON-real-store: calls=3 reported=67 withinBound=true disk=31457342 exceedsBound=true\",\"## Known limitations\",\"B-3434:F-033\",\"B-3434:F-035\",\"B-3434:F-036\",\"B-3434:F-037\"];if(!must.every(x=>s.includes(x)))process.exit(1);console.log(\"B-2220 happy-1 PASS\");"

happy.desc: The executable validation-evidence smoke accepts the current declined/no-active-follow-up decision, and a build-binding check proves the executed dist matches the edited source; WHY: the repository contract must agree with the decision document.

edge.desc: The decision explicitly states that measuring and writing one serialized byte string would not establish input consistency, semantic consistency, or evidence truth; WHY: this is the key limitation that makes the proposed refactor disproportionate.

edge.desc: The document gives concrete evidence-based reconsideration triggers rather than saying the proposal is abandoned forever; WHY: the choice should remain reversible if the risk profile changes.

verification.command: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");const s=fs.readFileSync(\"docs/requirements/decisions/validation-evidence-artifact-growth.md\",\"utf8\");const must=[\"production path begins accepting stateful or untrusted record objects\",\"store serialisation format changes independently\",\"normal validation evidence repeatedly approaches the configured advisory or bound\",\"a real measure/write mismatch occurs\",\"release, compliance or threat-model requirement demands a hard on-disk byte bound\",\"Reconsideration requires a new human-approved story\"];if(!must.every(x=>s.includes(x)))process.exit(1);console.log(\"B-2220 edge-1 PASS\");"

adversarial.desc: Active stale mandates are absent: no unassigned owner, work-order declaration, or sentence saying a follow-up story should be scoped; WHY: leaving any of these would contradict the new disposition.

verification.command: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");const s=fs.readFileSync(\"docs/requirements/decisions/validation-evidence-artifact-growth.md\",\"utf8\");const modal=\"(?:must(?!\\\\s+not)|should|shall|needs? to)\";const bad=[new RegExp(\"(?:follow-up owner|owner of the follow-up)[^\\\\n]*(?:TBD|unassigned|assigned)\",\"i\"),new RegExp(\"(?:follow-up story|proposal|boundary|new story)[^\\\\n]*(?:\"+modal+\"|work order)\",\"i\"),new RegExp(\"(?:\"+modal+\")[^\\\\n]*(?:follow-up story|proposal|boundary|new story)\",\"i\"),/this document is the work order/i];if(bad.some(r=>r.test(s)))process.exit(1);console.log(\"B-2220 adversarial-0 PASS\");"

adversarial.desc: The independently reviewed final decision record remains byte-for-byte unchanged after acceptance; WHY: an exact digest catches any later paraphrased mandate or deletion without pretending a keyword list can prove arbitrary natural-language semantics. A future document edit must establish a new reviewed decision and digest.
